name: prometheus-exporters
title: Prometheus exporters
description: Node Exporter (host CPU, memory, disks, network) and cAdvisor (per-container resources) for the Prometheus template. Both listen on 127.0.0.1 only; deploy into the stack that runs Prometheus and add the scrape targets node-exporter:9100 and cadvisor:8080 to its prometheus.yml.

policy_needs.reason: cAdvisor reads every container's file system from the host's root (read-only)
cAdvisor reads every container's cgroup figures from /sys (read-only)
cAdvisor reads the disks' input/output statistics through /dev/disk
cAdvisor's documented setup runs privileged to measure every container from the host's side
the node exporter measures the host's file systems: it reads the host's root (read-only)
the node exporter counts and measures the host's processes: it needs the host's process list
